import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

y=0.52
for _,r in tab.sort_values("n_respairs",ascending=False).iterrows():
    runs=[]; v=sorted(res[(res.ift38_chain=="I")&(res.partner_repeat==1)&(res.partner.str.contains(r.partner.split()[0].replace("IFT57","57").replace("IFT20","20") if False else ""))].index) # placeholder

ax.set_xlim(0,L+5); ax.set_ylim(0,0.8); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("Chlamydomonas IFT38 / CLUAP1 residue")

         "IFT54 (DYF-11)":"IFT54","IFT88 (OSM-5)":"IFT88"}
y=0.55
for _,r in tab.sort_values("n_respairs",ascending=False).iterrows():
    y-=0.08
    sub=res[(res.ift38_chain=="I")&(res.partner==PARTMAP[r.partner])&(res.partner_repeat==1)]
    rs=sorted(sub.iloc[0].ift38_res)
    for x in rs:
        ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((x-0.5,y),1.6,0.045,fc=colors[r.partner],ec="none"))
    ax.text(L+8,y+0.02,f"{r.partner}  ({r.n_respairs} res pairs)",fontsize=8,va="center",color=colors[r.partner])
ax.set_xlim(0,L+170)

# B: pLDDT of DYF-3
